summary: Analytics and insights professional with ~7 years across asset management, pension, and insurance clients — directly aligned to the Director, Business Analytics & Insights mandate. Holds delegated sign-off on valuation, sensitivity, and portfolio analytics delivered to institutional portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement at Moody's Analytics, translating those outputs into executive- and investment-committee-ready reporting. Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into auditable Python pipelines, and partners with product, technology, and client stakeholders on model governance, validation, and reporting quality. CFA; dual MSc.

sections.heading: Analytics, Insights & Executive Reporting
bullets: Holds delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and portfolio analytics delivered to institutional clients - portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement, ~$50bn+ cumulative - independently reviewing methodology and results before release.

Translates complex quantitative outputs into decision-ready reporting for senior stakeholders, covering portfolio exposures, scenario impacts, and balance-sheet sensitivities for investment committees.
Serves as escalation point for client-critical analytical issues, interfacing directly with clients' Heads of Risk and investment stakeholders.

sections.heading: Advanced Analytics & Solution Build
bullets: Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash-flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenario analysis across multi-year horizons.
Architected configurable time-bucketed analytics (T+1 through multi-year) enabling funding, refinancing, and asset-allocation decisions for institutional clients.

Built agentic AI development workflows (Claude Code, Cursor IDE) automating code generation, validation scaffolding, anomaly detection, and documentation - cutting development cycle time an estimated 30-40% on comparable modules.

sections.heading: Data Quality, Model Governance & Auditability
bullets: Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into scalable Python analytics pipelines with embedded logging, validation, and auditability controls.
Serves on the model governance committee, contributing to methodology review, documentation and benchmarking standards, and model-performance assessment for client-delivered analytics.
Reviews aggregation logic converting security-level exposures into portfolio-level metrics feeding downstream reporting; mentors junior colleagues within the ~12-person Modelling Services team.

Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms adopting the PFaroe DB (risk & ALM) and PFaroe PM (portfolio management) analytics platforms.
Acted as technical liaison between client investment teams and product owners - scoping business requirements into development requests and validating model outputs post-deployment.
Contributed to the successful migration of all assigned client accounts from the legacy Calypso platform to PFaroe PM.
Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 transformation programs for Canadian and international insurers, aligning reporting requirements with system implementation.
Coordinated actuarial, finance, IT, risk, and program-management teams on milestone delivery and implementation materials.
Developed advisory product offerings and go-to-market collateral for IFRS 17 implementation services.
Presented study findings and allocation recommendations directly to investment committees at Canadian pension-fund clients.

Performed asset-only and asset-liability portfolio optimization on VaR and CVaR using Ortec's GLASS platform, with risk decomposition and near-optimal frontier analysis to test the robustness of recommendations.
Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators assessing interest-rate risk and funding volatility under base-case and stressed environments.
Delivered ALM studies for pension funds and institutional investors - funding ratios, duration mismatch, and long-term balance-sheet exposures.
Led onboarding and the ALM study for a three-plan university pension merger on a team of three, developing and validating the model capturing all funding-policy dynamics.
